 Welcome, 2019 Door County Kayak Tours Guides!
Congratulations on receiving your invitation to guide training camp. We love to have fun during the summer and in order to do that we all need to know proper safety techniques and the logistics of how things run around the shop. During training camp please come ready to learn and bring plenty of water, snacks, lunch and anything else that will keep you on track for success.

What You Will Need

Training camp is from 7:00 am-5:00 pm please show up 20 minutes early to Cave Point Paddle & Pedal 6329 HWY 57 Jacksonport, WI.

Here is the manual. Please have this easily accessible on your phone—or print it out—so you can follow along as we go over it.

Please fill out this w4 and email it—along with a photo of your driver’s license—to [email protected].

Please fill out the first page of this i9, and email it to [email protected].

Get CPR/First Aid Certified here.

 Cancellation Policy

You have 48 hours before the tour to cancel and still receive a refund.

If there are strong winds and waves, we try to get you rescheduled to another time. If you do not have other availability we will kayak a more protected location, like the caves, wetlands or another bluff location. This happens about 10-15% of our tours. Sorry we are not able to control the weather…yet. We will issue you a return discount to come back if we are not able to safely see your requested tour location.

If there is lightning/thunder, we try our best to reschedule the tour to a later time or day. If you are not able to make a later time, we will refund you your deposit.
